turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone and called me?
You didn't answer me. Was Owen even spoken to before that mark went in, or did he find out on his phone like I think he did?
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.

What file, on what date, and where does a number like 11:52 PM come from? I'm not taking times off your lips, Hale, show me the document. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?

I'm not doing your arithmetic for you, Hale. You're walking me toward a conclusion one question at a time, and I've sat across from better at that. Show me the document with a date on it, or answer my question about Owen.
What time is it now, by the way?
Twenty past four, which leaves me twenty minutes before my call. You're spending them on small talk. Document, or I'm going upstairs.
